items.prompt: parse_cents("12x") and parse_cents("+") are called. Neither has an integer-range error. Which outcome follows from the full-field contract?

options.why: Prefix conversion is not full-field success, and the API does not define an empty post-plus field as zero.
12 fits the supported int range; trailing data is a syntax/consumption failure, not a numeric range failure.
The first call leaves x unconsumed; the second has no digits after removing plus. Both violate the field grammar.
from_chars can parse a numeric prefix, but the wrapper requires its pointer to reach the view end.
